name: Python Automation Developer
title: Python Automation Developer
description: Master enterprise test automation and scripting with Python. Advanced language features (decorators, generators, async), Pytest framework mastery, Playwright browser automation, API automation, CI/CD execution, test data management, and the bridge to AI-assisted automation.

levels.title: Level 0 — Advanced Python for Automation Engineers
levels.description: Advanced Python idioms: Decorators, context managers, generators, custom exceptions, typing, and async execution.

subjects.title: Advanced Python Mechanics
subjects.description: Core subject domain covering Advanced Python Mechanics.

topics.title: Decorators, Context Managers & Generators
topics.description: Write custom decorators for retries, timing, logging, and context managers for resource handling.
learningObjectives: Understand internal architecture and core mechanics of Decorators, Context Managers & Generators
Implement production-grade components using industry best practices for Decorators, Context Managers & Generators
Diagnose runtime errors, misconfigurations, and edge cases in Decorators, Context Managers & Generators
Explain design trade-offs and answer senior technical interview questions on Decorators, Context Managers & Generators

learningItems.title: Function & Class Decorators (@retry, @timing, @log_step)
Custom Context Managers with contextlib and __enter__/__exit__
Generators, yield from, and Memory-Efficient Stream Processing
Type Hinting & Static Analysis with MyPy / Pydantic V2
Asyncio Fundamentals: Event Loops, coroutines, tasks, and concurrency
